global_fields.name: capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: Maximum total weight the backpack can carry. The sum of weights of all selected tackle pieces must not exceed this pack weight limit.

linear_item_fields.name: item_id

linear_item_fields.name: linear_profit

weight_item_fields.name: item_id

weight_item_fields.name: weight

quadratic_item_fields.name: item_i_id

quadratic_item_fields.name: item_j_id

quadratic_item_fields.name: quadratic_profit

global_fields.name: capacity

linear_item_fields.name: item_id

linear_item_fields.name: linear_profit

weight_item_fields.name: item_id

quadratic_item_fields.name: item_i_id

quadratic_item_fields.name: item_j_id

quadratic_item_fields.name: quadratic_profit
quadratic_item_fields.scenario_description: Additional shooting value (positive or negative) realized only if both gear_i and gear_j are packed — represents complementary creative options enabled by that specific combination (e.g., a flash plus a modifier producing distinctive results).

quadratic_item_fields.name: item_i_id

quadratic_item_fields.name: item_j_id

global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of distinct small plates available to choose from for the tasting platter.

global_fields.name: items
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers (IDs or names) for each small plate option the kitchen can put on the platter.

global_fields.name: capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: Maximum total platter space available (in consistent units) that the selected plates must not exceed.

linear_item_fields.name: item_id
linear_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier for a single small plate (matches an entry from the global plate_ids list).

linear_item_fields.name: linear_profit
linear_item_fields.scenario_description: Base customer satisfaction points gained if that specific plate is included on the tasting platter (independent of other plates).

weight_item_fields.name: item_id
weight_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier for a single small plate (same ID used to reference its space usage on the platter).

weight_item_fields.name: weight
weight_item_fields.scenario_description: Amount of platter space that plate occupies (in the same units as platter_capacity); the sum of chosen plates' space must not exceed platter_capacity.

quadratic_item_fields.name: item_i_id
quadratic_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the first plate in a specific pairwise combo that may create extra enjoyment when both are served.

quadratic_item_fields.name: item_j_id
quadratic_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the second plate in the pair; used with plate_i_id to define a pairing bonus when both plates are selected.

quadratic_item_fields.name: quadratic_profit
quadratic_item_fields.scenario_description: Additional satisfaction points awarded if both plates in the specified pair are included on the tasting platter (can be positive or negative).

global_fields.name: num_items
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of distinct furniture pieces available to choose from for loading the rental truck.

global_fields.name: items
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers (IDs or labels) for each furniture piece; these IDs are referenced in the per-piece weight and value entries and in pair bonuses.

global_fields.name: capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: Maximum total weight the rental truck can carry (weight allowance). The sum of the weights of all selected pieces must not exceed this limit.

linear_item_fields.name: item_id
linear_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the furniture piece to which the base resale/reuse value applies (matches an ID from the global piece_ids list).

linear_item_fields.name: linear_profit
linear_item_fields.scenario_description: Base value (resale or reuse value) gained if this particular furniture piece is loaded onto the truck; added to the total value when the piece is selected.

weight_item_fields.name: item_id
weight_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the furniture piece for which a weight is specified (must match an ID from the global piece_ids list).

weight_item_fields.name: weight
weight_item_fields.scenario_description: Weight of the furniture piece (in the same units as the truck weight limit) that contributes to the truck's load when the piece is selected.

quadratic_item_fields.name: item_i_id
quadratic_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the first furniture piece in a specific pair that may create additional value when both pieces are loaded together.

quadratic_item_fields.name: item_j_id
quadratic_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the second furniture piece in the pair that, together with the first, can generate an extra joint value if both are selected.

quadratic_item_fields.name: quadratic_profit
quadratic_item_fields.scenario_description: The extra value (bonus) realized if both pieces in this pair are loaded together — e.g., matching table and chairs increasing resale — which is added to the total value only when both items are selected.

global_fields.name: num_items
global_fields.scenario_description: The count of distinct equipment pieces available to consider stocking on the makerspace shelf.

global_fields.name: items
global_fields.scenario_description: The list of identifiers (IDs or labels) for each piece of equipment that can be placed on the shelf.

global_fields.name: capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The maximum total weight the single shelf can support; the sum of chosen equipment weights must not exceed this limit.

linear_item_fields.name: item_id
linear_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier for a single piece of equipment (matches an entry from equipment_ids) used to link its attributes.

linear_item_fields.name: linear_profit
linear_item_fields.scenario_description: The usefulness score contributed by having this equipment on the shelf alone (its individual value toward overall usefulness).

weight_item_fields.name: item_id
weight_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier for a single piece of equipment (corresponds to an equipment_ids entry) used to associate its weight.

weight_item_fields.name: weight
weight_item_fields.scenario_description: The weight of that equipment item (the amount it adds toward the shelf's total carried weight).

quadratic_item_fields.name: item_i_id
quadratic_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier for the first equipment in a pair whose joint presence may unlock extra combined usefulness.

quadratic_item_fields.name: item_j_id
quadratic_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier for the second equipment in a pair whose joint presence with the first may unlock extra combined usefulness.

quadratic_item_fields.name: quadratic_profit
quadratic_item_fields.scenario_description: The additional usefulness gained if both equipment_i_id and equipment_j_id are placed on the shelf together (represents synergy or unlocked combined capability).

global_fields.name: num_items
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of distinct promotional pieces (flyers and kits) available to choose from for packing the single courier bag.

global_fields.name: items
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for each promotional piece (each flyer or kit) that can potentially be included in the bag.

global_fields.name: capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: Maximum allowed total weight the courier bag can carry; the sum of selected item weights must not exceed this limit.

linear_item_fields.name: item_id
linear_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier for a single promotional piece (a flyer or kit) referenced when specifying its individual outreach value.

linear_item_fields.name: linear_profit
linear_item_fields.scenario_description: The individual outreach contribution (base profit) gained if that specific promotional piece is included in the bag.

weight_item_fields.name: item_id
weight_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier for a single promotional piece (flyer or kit) referenced when specifying its weight.

weight_item_fields.name: weight
weight_item_fields.scenario_description: Weight of the promotional piece (in the same units used for bag_capacity); used to ensure the total packed weight does not exceed the bag capacity.

quadratic_item_fields.name: item_i_id
quadratic_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier for the first promotional piece in an interaction pair; used together with material_j_id to specify a pair bonus.

quadratic_item_fields.name: item_j_id
quadratic_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier for the second promotional piece in an interaction pair; when both this and material_i_id are selected, the pair bonus applies.

quadratic_item_fields.name: quadratic_profit
quadratic_item_fields.scenario_description: Extra outreach gained if both promotional pieces in the specified pair are included in the bag (can be positive or negative), representing synergy or redundancy.

global_fields.name: num_items
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of distinct product samples available to choose from for the mailer; the solver expects this count to match the number of sample entries listed elsewhere.

global_fields.name: items
global_fields.scenario_description: A list of identifiers for each product sample (e.g., SKU or index). These IDs are referenced by the weight, base conversion value, and pair-bonus entries.

global_fields.name: capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: Maximum total weight the mailer can hold (the weight limit for the kit). All chosen samples' weights must sum to no more than this capacity.

linear_item_fields.name: item_id
linear_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier for a single product sample (must match one of the IDs from the global sample list).

linear_item_fields.name: linear_profit
linear_item_fields.scenario_description: The expected conversion value (base profit) contributed by including this single sample in the kit, counted if that sample is selected.

weight_item_fields.name: item_id
weight_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier for a single product sample (used to link the weight to the same sample referenced elsewhere).

weight_item_fields.name: weight
weight_item_fields.scenario_description: Physical weight of the sample (same units as the mailer capacity). Weights of all selected samples are summed and must not exceed the mailer_capacity.

quadratic_item_fields.name: item_i_id
quadratic_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the first sample in a synergistic pair; must match an ID from the global sample list.

quadratic_item_fields.name: item_j_id
quadratic_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the second sample in a synergistic pair; must match an ID from the global sample list.

quadratic_item_fields.name: quadratic_profit
quadratic_item_fields.scenario_description: Additional conversion value gained if both samples in this pair are included in the kit (represents the extra lift from sending the two samples together). This value is added only when both sample_i and sample_j are selected.

global_fields.name: num_items
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of distinct props available to choose from for transporting to the shoot; used to understand how many item records follow.

global_fields.name: items
global_fields.scenario_description: The list of prop identifiers (names or IDs) that label each available prop you can load into the vehicle.

global_fields.name: capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The maximum total weight the vehicle can carry (capacity of the single car). All chosen props' weights must sum to no more than this limit.

linear_item_fields.name: item_id
linear_item_fields.scenario_description: The identifier for this prop (matches an entry in the props_list) used to tie its weight and any pair bonuses to this specific prop.

linear_item_fields.name: linear_profit
linear_item_fields.scenario_description: The production value (base profit) gained by bringing this prop to set on its own, added to the total if the prop is selected.

weight_item_fields.name: item_id
weight_item_fields.scenario_description: The identifier for this prop (matches an entry in the props_list) used to associate its weight with the prop.

weight_item_fields.name: weight
weight_item_fields.scenario_description: The weight of the prop (in the scenario's weight units). The sum of selected props' weights must not exceed the vehicle_capacity.

quadratic_item_fields.name: item_i_id
quadratic_item_fields.scenario_description: The identifier of the first prop in a specific pair that may yield an extra scene value when both are transported.

quadratic_item_fields.name: item_j_id
quadratic_item_fields.scenario_description: The identifier of the second prop in the pair; together with prop_i_id this defines a pair that can produce additional production value if both are selected.

quadratic_item_fields.name: quadratic_profit
quadratic_item_fields.scenario_description: The additional production value (bonus) obtained only if both props in the pair (prop_i_id and prop_j_id) are included in the vehicle load; add this to the total when both are selected.
